summary: Added canon note SS-025 on listing permission rails and platform-mediated lodging legality, broadened the archive into urban housing and tourism governance, and tightened portfolio-map-to-registry synchronization.
meta_claim: Cheap cognition raises the strategic value of scarce complements, gatekeepers, allocation surfaces, proof surfaces, status surfaces, query surfaces, observability layers, transaction rails, relay surfaces, and software-governed rights surfaces such as legally effective originals and organisational authority credentials.

counterfactual_shadow.rejected_move: Promote a telecom caller-authentication / robocall-trust note as the next broadening move.
counterfactual_shadow.why_rejected: The telecom move is real but still narrower and less institutionally cross-cutting than lodging-registration stacks, which now join city housing politics, national registries, EU interoperability, and platform transaction controls in one clearer branch.
